acceptance_conditions: scientific payload hash identical across every run of a phase
unexplained error count = 0 in every run
swap growth = 0 bytes in every run
peak total RSS (parent + workers) <= 24 GiB in every run
data units / evaluation rows / PH windows equal the frozen G3 counts of the phase

compute_identity.thread_env_rule: set by scripts/frozen_env.py before the interpreter starts

decision_rule.else: choose the candidate with the higher median throughput
decision_rule.statistic: median of the three per-run throughputs (computed PH windows / wall seconds)

failure_action: any failed acceptance condition voids this confirmation and requires a new preregistration; no re-run to improve a number

prior_evidence.note: the 8-replicate sweep pointed at w=12 (H0 +8.1%, H1 +6.3% vs w=8); that measurement is 8 replicates per cell and is demoted to historical diagnostic under this protocol

prohibitions: no parameter, code or environment change between the paired runs
no result-dependent choice of run order
no discarding of a completed run
no use of the 8-replicate sweep as the confirmation
purpose: confirm or falsify the frozen COMPUTE_SPEC.w_star=8 on the full 32-replicate smoke worklist with paired alternating worker counts
worklist: full 32-replicate smoke worklist (scope.R0_SMOKE = 32; no replicate limit)
